title: Parking Programme Terms for Direct Bookings: How the Weekly Parking Maximum Is Built for Elite Members (Guest Folios)
content:
For Ashbury Rewards elite members whose stays were booked directly, the stay's weekly parking maximum on Guest Folios is built by a method set by tier and booking channel.

**Terms.** Maximum method: for an Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite member whose stay was booked through a direct channel — the brand website, the mobile app, the call centre or the hotel directly — the maximum is pro-rated, every night parked counted at one seventh of the weekly rate; for an Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite or Platinum Elite member whose stay was booked through a direct channel it is the weekly rate for each full week plus the remaining nights at the weekly basis rate, the remaining nights together never charged more than half the weekly rate. Every other guest, including one whose stay was booked through a travel agency or a group rooming list, has no method under these terms.

The booking channel is read from the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio, and the tier from the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay. A full week is seven nights parked.

## Method by tier and channel

| Ashbury Rewards tier | Booking channel on the Room Reservations record | Maximum before rounding |
|---|---|---|
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | Direct | The weekly rate divided by seven, multiplied by the nights parked |
| Gold Elite or Platinum Elite | Direct | The weekly rate for each full week, plus the lower of the remaining nights at the weekly basis rate and half the weekly rate |
| Any tier | Online travel agency, travel agency or group rooming list | No method under these terms |
| Member or Silver Elite | Any | No method under these terms |

## Worked figures (hypothetical weekly basis rate $40.00, weekly rate $240.00)

- **Pro-rated, 9 nights parked.** $240.00 divided by seven is about $34.2857 a night; for 9 nights, $308.571…, which becomes $308.57 when the stay's maximum is rounded half up to the cent.
- **Gold or Platinum Elite, 12 nights parked.** One full week at $240.00; the 5 remaining nights at $40.00 come to $200.00, more than half the weekly rate of $120.00, so they count $120.00; the maximum is $360.00.
- **Gold or Platinum Elite, 9 nights parked.** One full week at $240.00; the 2 remaining nights come to $80.00, below $120.00, so they count $80.00; the maximum is $320.00.
